systems.country_label: national health information systems / DHIS2 implementation

note: Deal record: USAID's Notre Santé programme (US$28,749,042 committed 2023, to run 2023-2028) is described as supporting national health information systems, DHIS2 implementation and health data governance; DHIS2 is named without any description of what it reports, so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
